responsibility: Provides low-level bit-value transfer functions used by the tree SSA constant-propagation machinery. The declared helpers compute abstract result bit masks for unary and binary tree operations, supporting CCP-style reasoning about partially known integer values rather than defining a standalone pass interface.
same_name_distinction: This header is not the full CCP pass interface; it only declares low-level abstract bit-value transfer helpers for unary and binary operations. The actual conditional constant propagation pass, lattice engine use, and companion pass implementations live in gcc/tree-ssa-ccp.cc.
